name: Amour et Rêve
source: Toma, a young man of 16, has the same dream every night. There, a woman tries to say something, but her voice is too small so he can't heard them. One day when he returned from school, he met the woman who appeared inside his dream. Who is she?
translation: 16岁的Toma每晚都会做同一个梦。梦里，一名女子试图对他说些什么，可她的声音太轻，他听不清内容。一天放学回家后，他遇见了梦中出现的那名女子。她究竟是谁？
